editorial_position: 把作品放到公众面前，陈列就已经开始做判断。贸易展、珠宝展与音乐节目，分别通过进入方式、相邻对象和出场顺序，改变我们理解文化的条件。

art_direction.dominant_mood: 藕灰纸面上的朱红括号与梅墨字
art_direction.background_logic: 两枚朝内的宽括号围住不居中的色面，把并置关系留在纸上。
art_direction.palette_logic: 藕灰 #E6DBE1、梅墨 #392C35、朱红 #AA392D；以轻纸感承载清楚的阅读。
art_direction.type_scale_logic: 大标题与紧凑编号建立层级，正文稳定，短标签保留印刷笔触。
art_direction.image_behavior: 一手外链图片保持原色；肖像和展览图均明确出处，不冒充现场报道。
art_direction.page_density_and_tempo: 三篇依次从时装、珠宝到音乐，以相邻关系串起陈列的判断。
art_direction.core_visual_action: 括号把不相同的对象放在同一视野，中央空白邀请读者作比较。
art_direction.cover_composition: 两枚不对称朱红括号夹住三张小色片，刻意留出宽阔空白；原创构图。
art_direction.desktop_interaction_mechanic: 沿用三种阅读房间与原生链接；正文无需动态效果。
art_direction.behance_viewing_arc: 公众入口、观看位置、节目相邻关系，最后回到读者自己的选择。
art_direction.mobile_translation: 封面括号收窄，文章选读双栏；全文单栏。
art_direction.mobbin_usability_constraint: 保留 44px 操作、键盘焦点和图片失败回链。
art_direction.quiet_ending: 末尾保留开放的括号，让选择继续。

closing_quotation.text: An entrance is already an editorial decision.

closing_palette.rationale: 藕灰和梅墨保持正文对比，朱红用作小标题与括号；与前后期的纸色和图形不同。

variation_review.exception_reason: Owner-authorized retrospective edition uses open brackets and juxtaposed slips. Shared reading-room presentation follows the approved maintenance release.

stories.title: CENTRESTAGE：买手之外，谁能进入时装

english.title: WHO GETS ONTO THE FLOOR?
english.deck: CENTRESTAGE opens its trade floor to a public that can browse, try and buy.
english.abstract: The organiser scheduled CENTRESTAGE for 2–5 September and opened it to both buyers and the public. Its Hype² and fragrance sections widen the ways visitors can encounter fashion. Public access alone does not establish design quality or commercial success.

sources.title: 宝格丽 KALEIDOS 万花绮镜：色彩·文化·匠艺

english.title: JEWELLERY IN A DIFFERENT FRAME
english.deck: Kaleidos places jewellery alongside questions of colour, culture and light.
english.abstract: PSA lists Kaleidos from 5 September to 31 October 2026 on its second floor. Three chapters organise jewellery and contemporary works through colour, symbolism and light. The exhibition offers a viewing context; its brand-led narrative is not an independent verdict on cultural value.

sources.title: Nicholas Johnson and Friends — Concert Repertoire

english.title: ONE QUARTET, SEVERAL TRADITIONS
english.deck: A Grand Canyon programme places Mendelssohn, Eleanor Alberga and Jerod Tate together.
english.abstract: The festival lists Nicholas Johnson and Friends for 5 September at 7:30 p.m., with works by Mendelssohn, Eleanor Alberga and Jerod Impichchaachaaha’ Tate. The programme supports a reading of juxtaposition, not a claim about how the performance sounded. The image is a composer portrait, not a concert photograph.
